items.html: Understand and see how the entire upper externality becomes an interior to the internality below it, and that lower internality returns to the secret of externality, and then the first externality that was initially over the lower internality can no longer stand there and descends to become an internality within an even lower internality. And so it is in this manner until the end of all the degrees. In such a way that there can only be two phases there, which are one internality and one externality.
